visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with brown hair and glasses, wearing a white button-down shirt, sits on a beige sofa. He holds a white plate with a piece of toast topped with an egg, taking a large bite with an enthusiastic expression. The background is a clean indoor setting with a black cabinet and decorative items. (2) The scene shifts to a modern kitchen with white cabinetry and a minimalist backsplash. The man stands facing the camera, gesturing with his hands as he speaks. He points toward the kitchen counter where a sink and built-in appliances are visible under bright indoor lighting. (3) A close-up shot features a white plate holding two slices of purple-colored toast, each topped with a fried egg. The scene is bright and highlights the texture of the bread and the golden yolks of the eggs. (4) Back in the kitchen, the man holds up a bag of purple rice toast to the camera, emphasizing the product. He then opens a built-in refrigerator (Liebherr brand), showing various items inside, and pulls out two jars of strawberry jam and two fresh brown eggs. (5) The man places the toast into a white electric toaster. He then uses a black frying pan on a gas stove (Bertazzoni brand) to fry two eggs, pouring oil from a glass bottle. He uses a spatula to flip and transfer the cooked eggs onto a plate. (6) The man spreads two different types of strawberry jam onto the toasted bread using a knife. He then places the fried eggs on top of the jam-covered toast. (7) The focus shifts to a red and silver Miele coffee machine. It grinds and pours coffee into a white mug. The man is then shown holding the cup, taking a sip and looking satisfied. (8) The final phase shows the man back on the sofa, holding the plate of finished toast and the cup of coffee. He repeats the eating motion, smiling at the camera and gesturing to the food as if recommending it to the viewers.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a male voice expressing delight while chewing, accompanied by an upbeat, mid-tempo acoustic guitar and drum track. The music is cheerful and bright. (2) A sharp transition occurs as the man greets the audience with a friendly, high-energy tone. The background music continues at a steady volume, providing a rhythmic base for his fast-paced narration. (3) A distinct mechanical clicking sound is heard as toast is placed in a toaster, followed by the sound of eggs cracking. These incidental noises are crisp and well-captured in the mix. (4) The sound of oil sizzling in a pan ('滋滋滋') is prominent, mixing with the man's enthusiastic commentary about the 'sound of happiness.' The BGM remains constant in the background. (5) A mechanical pop and whirring sound signifies the coffee machine grinding and pouring liquid into a cup. The pouring sound has a high spectral bandwidth, clearly indicating liquid motion. (6) The vocal delivery becomes more relaxed and satisfied toward the end, with audible sipping and exhaling sounds ('啊 嘶') after drinking the coffee. The music swells slightly for the outro before fading out.
